eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Yavapai, AZ; at 4:23 PM on AUG 13, 2025 Effective until 2:23 AM AUG 14, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Yavapai County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Cottonwood Police Department is looking for 73 year old Gary Michael Riordan. Gary is a white male, 6 feet 5 inches tall, 185 pounds, with grey hair and brown eyes. Unknown clothing description. Last seen on foot on 08/06/2025 at his residence in the area of 800 North 15th Street. If you have seen Gary, please contact the Cottonwood Police Department at 928-649-1397 or call 911. If you have contact with this Silver Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
